difficulty_reason: The Hartogs construction: bounded-rank Separation plus Replacement collecting order types, a transitivity check driven by initial segments, and a reductio; four named cross-chapter citations, 30-line proof, the construction is written out in full.

primary.label: author lem environment with its own label HartogsLemma (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 674-676

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lem: Pairs (B,R) with B a subset of A and R a well-ordering of B all live in a bounded rank stage V of rank(A)+5 by the rank computation lemma; Separation forms the set C of such well-orderings, Replacement and the ordinal representation theorem collect their order types into a set alpha, transitivity of alpha makes it an ordinal, and a reductio shows no injection from alpha into A exists. (source lines 678-707)
